description: This file is a test suite using pytest for testing modules related to Python type tutorials in a FastAPI project. It defines fixtures for importing modules dynamically and contains test functions that verify the behavior of the 'say_hi' function within different modules, ensuring correct print outputs when called.

methods.name: get_module(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
